judgment_text:
Prayer : Writ Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India, praying this Court to issue a writ of mandamus, to direct the respondents to grant permission and police protection to celebrate the Kovilkodai in the said temple, namely, A/M Shri Petchiyamman, Shri Vembadisudalai Madasamy, Shri Petchiyamman Shri Vembadisudalai Madasamy, Shri Karupasamy, Shri Kombu Madasamy Thirukovil, situated at Oorudaiyarpuram, Nainarkulam Road, Tirunelveli Town, going to be held on 8-5-2026 and 9-5-2026 based upon the petitioner's representation dated 2-5-2026.

The Order of the Court was delivered by

S. Srimathy, J.:— The present Writ Petition is filed for Mandamus, directing the respondents to grant permission and police protection to celebrate the Kovil Kodai in the temple situated at Oorudaiyarpuram, Nainarkulam Road, Tirunelveli Town, to be held on 8-5-2026 and 9-5-2026, based upon the petitioner's representation dated 2-5-2026.

2. The learned government advocate (Crl. Side) submitted that the petitioner's application was considered and permission and protection were also granted with conditions vide communication of the third respondent dated 5-5-2026.

3. In view of the same, nothing survives for further adjudication. Hence, this Writ Petition is closed. However, if the petitioner is seeking any additional Police protection, the same may be granted at the expense of the petitioner. No costs.
